scenario.name: Ordinary home entry, first growth, undo and repeated growth
scenario.entryRequirement: Fresh isolated browser, ordinary URL, no QA or level override. Reload keeps this isolated journey. Review both runs independently.
scenario.validationStatus: Ordinary official release b8980c78 screenshot review confirms Enter/Enter opens 1-1, both growths complete (bud 0/1), and undo retracts the committed bridge (bud 1/1). Collector drains two actual animation frames before settling; early pre-drain validation is retained as a rejected measurement scenario.

phases.name: home-enter-game
phases.expected: Home closes and the current 1-1 garden becomes playable. No confirmation overlay remains.

phases.name: idle-before-growth
phases.expected: Both actors stand at the starting island beside the root.

phases.name: growth-first
phases.expected: Root bridge grows and settles. On the first run this is the first actual growth draw in this browser.

phases.name: undo-growth-first
phases.expected: Bridge retracts to the previous state. Verify visually before treating the next action as a repeat.

phases.name: growth-repeat
phases.expected: The same root bridge grows again.

phases.name: undo-growth-repeat
phases.expected: Return to the root's initial state so the same-context reload has the same action available.

phases.name: idle-after-actions
phases.expected: Stable garden, characters supported, controls visible.

scope: Fresh isolated browser profile does not guarantee empty OS/driver caches. No QA publisher. CDP TaskDuration is renderer main-thread task time, not isolated Godot CPU or GPU duration. GL wrappers measure synchronous API latency and add overhead. First action and repeated action must both be present and visually verified. Collection completion is not a frame-budget or gameplay pass.
